meta.name: The Perfect Lie
meta.description: After a heart-fluttering date, Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night. The next day, they meet at a police station with completely different memories. A shocking polygraph result turns their lives upside down.

videos.title: Date
videos.overview: Joonho and Jisun share a special night after their first date. The next day, everything changes.

videos.title: That Night
videos.overview: Joonho and Jisun remember the night differently. A polygraph points to an unexpected person.

videos.title: Two Faces
videos.overview: Joonho clears his name. Jisun finds a suspicious bottle at his home, but suspicion turns on her.

videos.title: Boomerang
videos.overview: Jisun pursues the truth while Joonho resumes his life. One night, they cross paths with Hwayoung.

videos.title: M
videos.overview: While tracing Joonho's late wife, Jisun uncovers another truth and makes a final move against him.

videos.title: The Victims
videos.overview: Jisun corners Joonho. The case doesn't just involve  her, and an unexpected visitor seeks him out.

videos.title: Monster
videos.overview: Shaken by a secret, Jisun fights on as suspicions around Joonho put those around him in danger.

videos.title: Liar
videos.overview: Jisun faces Joonho again, takes a dangerous step toward the hidden truth, and heads to the sea.
